title: Family Vegetable Quiche
subtitle: with roasted sweet potato, onion and mozzarella
description: A buttery shortcrust tart topped with mounds of roasted sweet potato, red onion and zucchini ribbons, with torn mozzarella and a light cream custard poured around.

steps.text: Make the pastry: mix the flour (140 g, chilled), the very cold diced butter and the egg yolk with the iced water in a mixer with a paddle for about 1 minute until crumbly. Gather into a ball and flatten into a 2 to 3 cm disc, handling as little as possible to keep it crisp. Wrap and chill for at least 2 hours or up to a day.

Preheat the oven to 150°C and grease a 24 cm pie tin. Roll out the pastry on a floured surface into a thin sheet, line the tin, pressing it into the sides and base, and prick with a fork. Cover with baking paper and fill with dry beans or chickpeas as weights. Bake for about 20 minutes until dry and set. Cool.

Preheat the oven to 200°C and line a tray with baking paper. Arrange the sweet potato (peeled, cut into finger-size strips) and red onions (peeled, cut into sixths) separately on the tray, brush with olive oil, season with salt and roast for about 20 minutes until soft and browned.
Lower the oven to 180°C. Arrange the zucchini ribbons (sliced lengthways with a peeler) and the roasted vegetables in separate mounds on the pastry shell, with torn pieces of mozzarella between them.

Whisk the cream, egg, 2 tbsp flour and a pinch of salt until smooth and pour carefully around the vegetables without mixing them. Scatter over the oregano leaves, drizzle with olive oil and bake for about 20 minutes until the filling is golden and set.
